Class Token

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.css.parser.Token
Direct Known Subclasses:
Token.CloseBrace, Token.CloseBracket, Token.CloseParen, Token.Colon, Token.Comma, Token.Delim, Token.EOF, Token.Hash, Token.Ident, Token.Number, Token.OpenBrace, Token.OpenBracket, Token.OpenParen, Token.Semicolon, Token.StringToken, Token.Variable, Token.Whitespace
public abstract class Token extends Object
Represents a token in the CSS lexer output.

Tokens are the building blocks produced by the lexer that the parser uses to construct the CSS AST.

    • precededByWhitespace

      public boolean precededByWhitespace()
      Returns whether this token was preceded by whitespace in the source. This is used to distinguish between compound selectors (Panel.class) and descendant selectors (Panel Button).
      Returns:
      true if preceded by whitespace
